mapper.select: SELECT MIN(c.IDEA_ID) as IDEA_ID, c.USER_ID, c.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, MIN(c.TITLE) as TITLE, MIN(c.CONTENT_TITLE) as CONTENT_TITLE, MIN(c.CONTENT_DESC_1) as CONTENT_DESC_1, MIN(c.CONTENT_DESC_2) as CONTENT_DESC_2, MIN(c.CONTENT_DESC_3) as CONTENT_DESC_3 FROM USER_COLLAB_IDEA c LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k ON c.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY c.USER_ID, c.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY MIN(c.IDEA_ID) DESC

SELECT c.IDEA_ID, c.USER_ID, c.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT_TITLE, c.CONTENT_DESC_1, c.CONTENT_DESC_2, c.CONTENT_DESC_3 FROM USER_COLLAB_IDEA c LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k ON c.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} ORDER BY c.IDEA_ID DESC
